title: Payment Methods won’t allow modifying fields for Naver Pay after the object is first created
summary: Removes the ability to update Naver Pay parameters on a PaymentMethod object. You can only set them when first creating a PaymentMethod. This change removes the ability to update Naver Pay parameters when you update a PaymentMethod.
migrationNotes: You can no longer use POST /v1/payment_methods/:id to update Naver Pay parameters. You can only set them when creating a PaymentMethod.

sources.quote: | [Payment Methods won’t allow modifying fields for Naver Pay after the object is first created](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/basil/2025-03-31/naver-pay-payment-method.md) | Payments | Breaking | api |
This change removes the ability to update Naver Pay parameters when you [update a PaymentMethod](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/update.md?api-version=2025-03-31.basil).
